query: According NIFC, from 2014 to 2024 (inclusive at both ends), which US state has the highest total number of lightning-caused wildfires across all NIFC Geographic Area Coordination Centers whose geographic boundaries intersect with that state? Use the latest report (by reported date) within each year. Give the full name of the state.
